text: This S1000D document provides a general description of s1kd-tools, a suite of utilities for manipulating S1000D technical data. It serves as an example S1000D dataset created using these tools and references related GitHub repositories for the s1kd-tools software and S1000D XSL stylesheets used to generate documentation outputs.

This S1000D document specifies the compatibility matrix between s1kd-tools (a suite of S1000D processing utilities) and different issues of the S1000D specification (versions 2.0 through 5.0). It documents which tools support which specification versions, using a legend indicating full support (X), partial support (/), planned support (blank), or no support (~). The document helps users understand tool compatibility across S1000D specification generations.

This S1000D data module documents the **s1kd-flatten** command-line tool, which merges publication modules and their referenced data modules into a single consolidated file for publishing systems. It specifies the tool's purpose, usage syntax, comprehensive option flags (including container flattening, directory searching, and XML parsing configurations), exit status codes, and practical examples. Issue 025 was updated in September 2020 to add XML catalog support.

# Document Summary

This S1000D document describes the **s1kd-icncatalog** tool, a command-line utility for managing and resolving Image and Graphic Notation (ICN) catalogs in S1000D technical documentation projects. It provides detailed information on the tool's purpose, usage syntax, command-line options, practical examples of ICN resolution for different output media, pattern-matching capabilities, and the XML schema structure of catalog files. Issue 020 was updated in September 2020 to add XML catalog parser support.
